title: The Pilot
summary: On Day ten, the stranger on the roof offers a way off the coast, for a price.

beats.text: Day ten. The stranger on the roof was Marek, a harbour pilot.
"The big boat is gone," he said. "But a fishing tug hides under Pier Four."
Below, the street crawled with them. Two miles to the water.
"It has no fuel," Marek said. "The diesel is in your basement generator."
Mrs. Okafor frowned. "Hale has the generator key. And Hale never mentioned a pilot."
beats.speaker: okafor

beats.text: Dara split our last can five ways. Leo pretended not to starve.
Marek counted us twice. Then Biscuit, and he smiled wrongly.
At dusk we crept to the lobby. The glass doors barely held.
The basement door stood open. Cold air smelled of oil.
Then Hale's walkie crackled. "Sam, do not trust the pilot. He is not alone."
beats.speaker: hale
